annotation_replies_source_identity_check.name: annotation_replies_source_identity_check
annotation_replies_source_identity_check.value:
("annotation_replies"."source_type" = 'NATIVE'
        and "annotation_replies"."author_id" is not null
        and "annotation_replies"."source_author_name" is null
        and "annotation_replies"."source_initials" is null
        and "annotation_replies"."source_created_at" is null
        and "annotation_replies"."source_comment_id" is null
        and "annotation_replies"."source_document_order" is null
        and "annotation_replies"."source_resolved" is null
        and "annotation_replies"."import_batch_id" is null
        and "annotation_replies"."imported_by_user_id" is null
        and "annotation_replies"."attributed_user_id" is null)
      or
      ("annotation_replies"."source_type" = 'DOCX_IMPORT'
        and "annotation_replies"."author_id" is null
        and "annotation_replies"."source_author_name" is not null
        and "annotation_replies"."source_comment_id" is not null
        and "annotation_replies"."source_document_order" is not null
        and "annotation_replies"."source_document_order" >= 0
        and "annotation_replies"."source_resolved" is not null
        and "annotation_replies"."source_resolved" in (0, 1)
        and "annotation_replies"."import_batch_id" is not null
        and "annotation_replies"."imported_by_user_id" is not null
        and "annotation_replies"."submission_key" = 'docx:' || "annotation_replies"."import_batch_id" || ':' || "annotation_replies"."source_comment_id")

annotations_source_identity_check.name: annotations_source_identity_check
annotations_source_identity_check.value:
("annotations"."source_type" = 'NATIVE'
        and "annotations"."author_id" is not null
        and "annotations"."source_author_name" is null
        and "annotations"."source_initials" is null
        and "annotations"."source_created_at" is null
        and "annotations"."source_comment_id" is null
        and "annotations"."source_document_order" is null
        and "annotations"."source_resolved" is null
        and "annotations"."import_batch_id" is null
        and "annotations"."imported_by_user_id" is null
        and "annotations"."attributed_user_id" is null)
      or
      ("annotations"."source_type" = 'DOCX_IMPORT'
        and "annotations"."author_id" is null
        and "annotations"."source_author_name" is not null
        and "annotations"."source_comment_id" is not null
        and "annotations"."source_document_order" is not null
        and "annotations"."source_document_order" >= 0
        and "annotations"."source_resolved" is not null
        and "annotations"."source_resolved" in (0, 1)
        and "annotations"."import_batch_id" is not null
        and "annotations"."imported_by_user_id" is not null
        and "annotations"."submission_key" = 'docx:' || "annotations"."import_batch_id" || ':' || "annotations"."source_comment_id")

notifications_import_batch_check.name: notifications_import_batch_check
notifications_import_batch_check.value:
("notifications"."notification_type" = 'DOCX_ATTRIBUTION_NOTICE' and "notifications"."import_batch_id" is not null and "notifications"."metadata_json" is not null)
      or ("notifications"."notification_type" <> 'DOCX_ATTRIBUTION_NOTICE' and "notifications"."import_batch_id" is null)
